title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2607.18601v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case approximate variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against dispersion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases - such as clustered exposure - and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. translated_title: 溢出效应实验中的稳健信号最大化
translated_abstract: 我们研究用于估计溢出效应的实验的最优设计与分析方法。在假设暴露映射已知（例如线性）的前提下，我们刻画了能够针对一大类不可观测变量分布最小化最坏情况近似方差的干预分配分布以及基于回归的估计量。设计问题得到了一个直观的解：规划者需要在溢出信号强度与溢出变异的离散程度之间进行权衡。分析问题则给出了一个简单的重新中心化工具变量估计量，以最佳利用这种变异。该框架在若干基准情形（如聚类暴露）下产生了自然的解，并为一般网络（包括二部图情形）提出了计算上可行的近似方法。我们基于发展经济学中的三个应用，通过半合成实验展示了这些新工具。我们的方法带来了大幅的标准误（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对存在溢出效应的实验，提出了在已知暴露映射下通过权衡信号强度与变异离散度的稳健最优设计，并配套重新中心化工具变量估计量，以最小化最坏情况方差、有效估计溢出效应。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a robust optimal design framework for spillover experiments that trades off signal strength against dispersion of spillover variation under a known exposure mapping, paired with a recentered instrumental variable estimator to minimize worst-case approximate variance.
